priorGoalTurn: Progress: square implementation was promoted, independently reviewed and validated; this turn confirmed its 17 source hashes before further changes.

issues.issue: Classic98 generic button background hid every palette color and replaced pressed colors with navy.
issues.reproduction: Both desktop and mobile Classic had 0/16 labeled colors displayed correctly; Studio had16/16. Color selection data itself was intact.
issues.rootCause: Higher-specificity root[data-skin=classic] button and :active/[aria-pressed] background rules override .swatches button.
issues.fix: Use the existing per-button --swatch with the normal panel/active accent fallback. No additional selector, helper or !important.
issues.scope: Mouse and keyboard active color checked. Emulated touch selected correctly; Chromium reported :active=false at the sampled touchStart, so this is not proof of physical touch pressed-state timing.

issues.issue: Global Enter intercepted native button activation and could settle a pending selection instead of choosing a color.
issues.reproduction: In four skin/viewport configurations, Enter on salmon left the previous purple selection. Space and pointer activation worked.
issues.rootCause: keyboard() unmodified Enter prevented default and called settle() even when the focused target was a button.
issues.fix: Only the existing Enter branch returns for HTMLButtonElement, letting the button run its normal action. Busy/dialog/IME/Escape/Ctrl-Cmd branches retain precedence.
issues.verification: Public palette Enter preserves a pending transparent selection; explicit canvas Enter settles it. Undo Enter, Redo Space, palette Enter/Space and existing clipboard/IME editing assertions pass.
issues.testAdjustment: Existing document-Enter tests now explicitly focus the canvas after save/menu operations. Expected RGBA and Undo assertions were not changed.

issues.issue: Pencil used nearest-pixel DDA and maximum coverage, disagreeing with the documented legacy one-pixel tool.
issues.reproduction: Actual legacy Canvas (8,8)→(15,9) confirmed the six-pixel discrepancy. Qt alpha128 press gives192 and a real same-floor move gives240; old routing gave128. Qt ignores UI opacity for Pencil; old routing at1% gave alpha3.
issues.rootCause: UI routed Pencil to the generic pixel stamp mode, which is a different engine contract. Existing generic-mode tests were not authoritative for application Pencil behavior.
issues.fix: Route Pencil size1/square=true through the already verified hard-square engine (pixel=false). Existing terminal/chord handling applies; no engine or project-format change.
issues.ui: Show1px, disable size/opacity/hardness/stabilization/pressure/square options, explain the fixed behavior, preserve stored round values, ignore size shortcuts while Pencil is selected. Explicit pixel preset still has its existing preset behavior.
issues.compatibility: Generic pixel/spray API remains unchanged. Ordinary alpha0 ink keeps the existing hidden-RGB no-op safety policy. Raw storage is straight RGBA; Qt premultiplied RGB rounding is not imposed.

architecture.moduleOwnership: UI selects the tool contract; existing engine owns pixels/history/cancel. Native packaging remains Windows/macOS only.

actualQtPencil.scope: Independent Qt Canvas versus proposed route in the unchanged engine. The47 translucent RGB differences of at most1 are reported as storage-policy differences, not accepted pixel-test tolerances.

publicPencilAndExistingTools.testExpectations: Source picker RGBA, all-layer hashes, visibility, clean and Redo expectations retained. Only the later Pencil press expectation separately applies two source-over passes. Full literal RGBA and Undo/Redo are checked without tolerance.

native.scope: Actual macOS persistence/recovery, codec, quit and render smoke on the final binary. The existing in-app square checks exercise JavaScriptCore, not actual Pencil pointer events. No native physical keyboard/pen/UI acceptance claimed.

priorCoreSuite.scope: Previous core evidence remains applicable to identical engine/codec source; it is not represented as a new test execution.

operationalNotes: Initial formatter invocation used repository-relative patterns from the wrong working directory and matched no files. The corrected invocation succeeded; no product failure or hidden test retry.

The complete palette-stage browser script used default storage/shear output locations. Original outputs were copied before either write; current outputs were moved into this stage and the originals restored byte-exact using the saved manifest. No historical result was replaced.

performance.claim: No drawing-speed improvement is asserted for CSS, keyboard ownership or Pencil routing. The old DDA and restored Pencil produce different output contracts, so a naive speedup comparison would be invalid.
performance.nextStep: Implement bounded source-mip preparation with a shared resumable cursor, preserve synchronous complete-scene publication and the existing factor1 fast path. Include mutation generation, cancellation, dirty ownership and scratch accounting before timing comparisons.
